title: Matrix Rank (Easy Version)
statementMd:
**This is the easy version of the problem. The only differences between the two versions of this problem are the constraints on $k$. You can make hacks only if all versions of the problem are solved.**

You are given integers $n$, $p$ and $k$. $p$ is guaranteed to be a prime number.

For each $r$ from $0$ to $k$, find the number of $n \times n$ matrices $A$ of the field$^\dagger$ of integers modulo $p$ such that the rank$^\ddagger$ of $A$ is exactly $r$. Since these values are big, you are only required to output them modulo $998\,244\,353$.

$^\dagger$ [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Field_(mathematics)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Field_(mathematics))

$^\ddagger$ [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rank_(linear_algebra)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rank_(linear_algebra))

## Input

The first line of input contains three integers $n$, $p$ and $k$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^{18}$, $2 \leq p \lt 998\,244\,353$, $0 \leq k \leq 5000$).

It is guaranteed that $p$ is a prime number.

## Output

Output $k+1$ integers, the answers for each $r$ from $0$ to $k$.
statementZhMd:
**这是本题的简单版本。该版本与完整版之间唯一的区别在于 $k$ 的约束。只有在所有版本的问题都解决后，才能进行 hack。**

给定整数 $n$、$p$ 和 $k$。保证 $p$ 是一个素数。

对于每个从 $0$ 到 $k$ 的 $r$，求由模 $p$ 的整数构成的域$^\dagger$上的所有 $n \times n$ 矩阵 $A$ 中，秩$^\ddagger$恰好为 $r$ 的矩阵数量。由于这些数可能很大，你只需要输出它们对 $998\,244\,353$ 取模后的结果。

$^\dagger$ [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Field_(mathematics)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Field_(mathematics))

$^\ddagger$ [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rank_(linear_algebra)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rank_(linear_algebra))

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个整数 $n$、$p$ 和 $k$（$1 \leq n \leq 10^{18}$，$2 \leq p \lt 998\,244\,353$，$0 \leq k \leq 5000$）。

保证 $p$ 是一个素数。

## 输出格式

输出 $k+1$ 个整数，分别表示 $r$ 从 $0$ 到 $k$ 时的答案。
